# stellar-pay

> Pay HTTP 402s in USDC from a Stellar wallet — x402 (exact scheme) and MPP
> (draft-stellar-charge-00) in one client, as a CLI, an MCP server, and an
> importable TypeScript library. Probed catalog of live Stellar-payable
> endpoints included.

Install: `npm i -g stellar-pay` (or `npx stellar-pay …`). Wallet =
STELLAR_SECRET_KEY or an encrypted keystore (`stellar-pay setup --save main`).

## Core

- CLI: `curl <url> [--yes --max-usd N] [--json]` pays a 402 and returns the
  body; `offers <url>` reads the challenge paying nothing; `verify <url>` is
  the seller-side correctness check; `search "<task>" --json` finds live paid
  endpoints; `run -- <cmd>` wraps any tool behind a paying proxy;
  `mcp` serves stdio; `claude|codex|goose` launch an agent with the MCP
  mounted. Exit codes: 0 ok · 2 usage · 3 payment refused · 4 no wallet.
- Library: `import { payFetch, readOffers, autoApprove, decide } from
  "stellar-pay"` — the same 402 loop in-process.
- MCP tools (26): discover & pay — search_catalog, list_catalog,
  get_catalog_entry, curl; wallet — get_balance, send_usdc (two-step),
  get_history; governance — begin_task, end_task, spend_report; sessions —
  session_open, session_status, session_close (+ curl{session:true}); hire —
  bounty_post, bounty_assign, bounty_open, bounty_dispute, bounty_resolve,
  bounty_status; earn — bounty_feed, bounty_pack, bounty_submit,
  bounty_submit_packet, bounty_watch; fund — vault_draw, vault_status.

## Spend control

Mainnet payments must be USDC, under STELLAR_PAY_MAX_USD_PER_CALL, inside
STELLAR_PAY_SESSION_BUDGET_USD, and allowed by the per-host policy file
(~/.config/stellar-pay/policy.json: per-host ceilings, deny, allowlist mode).
Inside a task, duplicate/fresh requests replay free and failing providers are
quarantined (Scrimp).

## Catalog (public feed)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stellar-Light/stellar-pay/catalog/catalog.json
Every row in the default view answered a real 402 on a network this catalog
claims, re-probed within the last 48 hours — the one exception is our own
testnet sandbox, marked source "curated". Rows carry: url, method, priceUSD,
protocol, networks, lastCheckedAt.
